Orange info banner data-testid='taxi-managed-elsewhere-note' present and explains taxi is managed in 'Catégories de service (Taxi)' — UX clear.

home_categories.py: routes properly protected by require_permission('content.manage') (admin list returns 401 unauthenticated). PUT accepts partial body incl. visible_home & label_fr; reorder accepts ordered_ids and sets display_order by index.
